artifact_type.PROTOCOL_FRAMEWORK: Protocol framework; may not expose all field-level specs publicly
artifact_type.PAYMENT_METHOD_SPEC: Documented payment method/spec embedded in a product ecosystem
artifact_type.DEVELOPER_TOOL: Integration/developer tool, not a payment protocol

maturity.PRODUCTION: Real production product or transaction capability
maturity.PRODUCTION_VALIDATION: Validated on production systems; not equivalent to general availability

stablecoin_relation.DIRECT: Stablecoin is an explicit/native payment path
stablecoin_relation.COMPATIBLE: Protocol explicitly supports stablecoins but is payment-agnostic
stablecoin_relation.INDIRECT: Stablecoin could appear only through lower payment infrastructure
stablecoin_relation.BLOCKCHAIN_NOT_STABLECOIN: Blockchain/tokenisation is used, but this is not evidence of stablecoin settlement
